postings.title: RF OTA Validation Specialist — Wireless Connectivity
top_requirements: Hands‑on experience validating radiated performance of WLAN, Bluetooth, and GNSS across OTA test chambers.
Ability to translate system‑level RF requirements into detailed test cases and measurement procedures.
Proficiency debugging OTA failures and coordinating third‑party lab certifications.
postings.summary: The role focuses on OTA validation of multi‑radio wireless devices at Apple, matching the candidate’s RF test background. It offers a hands‑on engineering position with a compensation level near the target.

postings.title: MultiRadio Coex Software Systems Engineer, Wireless Technologies & Ecosystems
top_requirements: Design and implement real‑time scheduling algorithms for concurrent operation of Wi‑Fi, Bluetooth, Cellular, and Satellite radios.
Develop and validate multi‑radio coexistence models using system‑level simulations and hardware prototypes.
Optimize cross‑technology interference mitigation techniques to meet stringent latency and throughput targets.
bonus_skills: Experience with Thread or Matter protocols
postings.summary: This Apple position engineers multi‑radio coexistence algorithms, directly leveraging the candidate’s RF systems and signal‑processing expertise. It is a senior technical role with a salary that meets the compensation goal.

postings.title: E2E Test Automation Engineer — Wireless Systems & Devices
top_requirements: Develop and maintain automated end‑to‑end test frameworks for LEO satellite‑IoT connectivity hardware.
Create Python‑based test scripts that exercise RF front‑ends, digital baseband, and network protocols.
Integrate hardware‑in‑the‑loop simulations with physical test rigs to validate system performance across temperature and vibration extremes.
postings.summary: E‑Space’s test‑automation role blends RF hardware validation with software automation, fitting the candidate’s hands‑on test expertise while moving away from pure aerospace hardware design. Compensation meets the $200K target range.

postings.title: Senior 6G Wireless Systems Engineer - Prototyping
top_requirements: Design, prototype, and validate 6G RF front‑end and baseband DSP blocks in lab testbeds.
Develop and execute over‑the‑air (OTA) and field trials to benchmark prototype performance against emerging standards.
Integrate hardware and software components, providing detailed measurement reports and improvement recommendations.
postings.summary: The PERSOL role focuses on hands‑on 6G prototype development, aligning with the candidate’s RF and signal‑processing background while moving toward next‑gen wireless. Salary estimate is competitive for senior talent in Singapore.

postings.title: Senior/Staff 6G Wireless Systems Architect
top_requirements: Architect and implement 6G modem and RF chain prototypes, including DSP algorithm integration.
Lead hardware‑software co‑development, ensuring timing closure and performance verification in testbeds.
Perform system‑level validation across lab and field environments, delivering benchmark reports for standardization bodies.
postings.summary: This senior architect role at PERSOL offers deep technical involvement in 6G modem systems, matching the candidate’s skill set and providing a pathway away from aerospace. Compensation is comparable to senior engineering roles in the region.

postings.title: Sr. RF DVT Engineer, Amazon Leo Silicon
top_requirements: Develop and execute RF Design Verification Test (DVT) plans for satellite‑borne modem ASICs.
Perform hands‑on measurements of gain, noise figure, IIP3, and EVM across the full RF chain.
Debug silicon issues through lab instrumentation and coordinate with layout and firmware teams for fixes.
bonus_skills: Knowledge of LEO satellite link budgets
postings.summary: The Sr. RF DVT Engineer at Amazon Leo provides deep RF validation work on satellite communication ASICs, a natural fit for the candidate’s RF test expertise. Compensation aligns with the $200K+ goal.
